definition: [ שֶׂ֫פֶק ] noun [masculine] doubtful word; hand-clapping , i.e. mockery (?) (compare verb Job 27:23 ); — שָׂ֑פֶק Job 36:18 in difficult clause ׳ כִּיחֵֿמָה פֶּןיְֿסִיתְךָ בְשׂ because there is passion , (beware) lest it incite thee to mockery , Bae Kau Da (but הסית בְּ = incite against , hence Bu reads לִשְׂפֹּק ); De is not clear; others (as Di ): lest it (passion) excite thee at the chastisement (see √ 2 ; compare Thes ); Du reads מִשְׂפָּק לְחֵמָה lest chastisement incite thee to wrath . — On Job 20:22 (editions) see שֵׂפֶק .
